walk_loop.desc: 4-beat lateral-sequence walk, IK-planted feet, stride synced to ground speed

run_loop.desc: transverse gallop: spine flex, pitch rock, IK feet, speed-synced

walk_start.desc: weight shifts forward, first steps; ends exactly on walk_loop phase 0

walk_stop.desc: decelerates over planted feet, last legs step into a square stance, body rocks back and settles

run_start.desc: anticipation crouch on the haunches, explosive push-off into run_loop phase 0

run_stop.desc: braking: forelegs plant ahead, weight thrown back on the haunches, head and tail swing up, settle

turn_left.desc: turn in place left: diagonal stepping around the body centre, chest leads, head looks into the turn, tail swings out

turn_right.desc: turn in place right: diagonal stepping around the body centre, chest leads, head looks into the turn, tail swings out

step_backward.desc: two wary backward steps: weight back, head drawn up, wings flare slightly, tail lifts

flight_flap.desc: powered flight: fast power stroke, half-folded recovery stroke, wing-tip lag, body heave, steady head

flight_ascend.desc: climbing: deeper, faster strokes, body pitched up, legs hanging, tail low as a rudder

flight_glide.desc: soaring: wings held out but never frozen - slow dihedral swell, finger ripple, membrane flutter, head scanning, tail rudder

flight_descend.desc: descending: wings raised in a V and swept back, tips buffeting, nose down, legs starting to drop, tail up as an air brake

flight_bank_left.desc: banking left (additive, weighted by turn rate): roll into the turn, head looks in and stays level, outer wing reaches, tail trails out

flight_bank_right.desc: banking right (additive, weighted by turn rate): roll into the turn, head looks in and stays level, outer wing reaches, tail trails out

landing_approach.desc: flare before touch-down: nose up, braking back-flaps, legs reaching for the ground, tail down, eyes on the spot

landing_impact.desc: touch-down: legs absorb the weight on planted feet, body dips and rebounds, wings snap up then fold shoulder->elbow->fingers, tail slams and settles

pre_takeoff.desc: anticipation: crouch on the haunches, wings unfold shoulder first and cock high, head looks up, tail lifts

launch.desc: explosive leg push on planted feet, huge first downstroke, legs trail then tuck, two climbing strokes; ends on flight_flap frame 0

idle_breathe.desc: standing base: chest and flanks breathe, shoulders and wings lift on the inhale, weight drifts side to side on planted feet, tail sways

idle_look_left.desc: eyes/head lead a quick glance left, the neck follows segment by segment, a curious tilt and a small re-fixation, head returns first

idle_look_right.desc: slow look to the right over the shoulder with the neck raised, a double-take, two sniffs and a tail flick

idle_sniff.desc: lowers chest and head to the ground, scans left-right with short sniff pulses and jaw twitches, smoke from the nostrils

idle_blink.desc: eyelids close and open (new eyelid bones, hidden inside the skull at rest); fired at random 2.5-6 s intervals on the client

idle_ground_scratch.desc: shifts weight onto the left legs, rakes the ground three times with the right fore-claws (claws curl on each stroke), watches the foot

idle_tail_sway.desc: slow S-wave travels down the tail (tip lags, grows), hips counter-sway, a glance back along the body

idle_wing_adjust.desc: half-opens the left wing (shoulder, elbow, fingers in turn), shakes it out, refolds, then a small shrug of the right wing

idle_stretch.desc: cat-like stretch: forelegs reach forward, chest dips while the hips stay up, neck extends, wings lift half open, tail stretches and shivers, then steps back

idle_yawn.desc: inhales, raises the head, jaw opens slowly to 46 deg with the eyes shut, a shudder, the jaw snaps shut, head shake

rest_lower.desc: lies down: hind legs fold first, then the forelegs, belly settles on the ground, neck and tail curl around to the left

rest_breathe.desc: (utility layer) slow deep breathing while lying down, a lazy tail-tip twitch

rest_rise.desc: gets up: head lifts and the neck uncurls first, forelegs push the chest up, hind legs follow, tail uncurls last, shakes off

alert.desc: head snaps up toward the intruder, body tenses into a low crouch, shoulders and wings lift off the back, tail rises stiff, low growl

roar.desc: anticipation: rears back and inhales (chest swells); action: thrusts forward, jaw wide, wings half-spread and trembling, head shake; recovery: settles

bite.desc: anticipation: coils the neck back, jaw opens, forelegs brace; action: accelerating lunge; impact 0.45 s: jaws snap with a shake; recovery: pulls back, overshoots, settles

claw_swipe.desc: anticipation: rears and loads onto the left, right foreleg cocked high; action: raking swipe across; impact 0.55 s; follow-through and twist; recovery: foot replanted

tail_smash.desc: anticipation: body winds up and the tail coils high to one side, looks back; action: whip across the rear arc (tip lags the base); impact 0.72 s slam; follow-through overshoot, settle

wing_buffet.desc: anticipation: rears onto the hind legs, wings open fully and cock high and back; action: massive forward sweep; impact 0.7 s gust; second beat; forefeet land, wings fold

fire_breath_charge.desc: building tension: neck coils into an S, chest swells, jaw cracks open with a glow, head trembles harder and harder, tail lashes

fire_breath_release.desc: the neck whips forward (overshoot), jaw slams open, a sustained jet with recoil shudder and a slow sweep; aim pitch from the server; flame geometry grows out of the mouth

hurt.desc: flinch: head jerks away and the body recoils in 0.06 s on planted feet, wings and tail twitch, everything settles back with a damped wobble

death.desc: (existing, improved) staggers in pain, a foreleg buckles, chest drops, rolls onto the side, wings sprawl, the head hits the ground and bounces, tail flops, last breath
